changes: original_meaning 前溯到链条真正的词源头：拉丁语 patronus「庇护人，保护人」，并在 how 链中写明『庇护人→榜样→图样』的转折（牛津明言 sense change 源自 patron 给出效仿榜样的观念）；现行字段从『榜样』起步，漏了词源头。
semantic_path 重建三站，how 补图样义（14 世纪末）、重复图案义（1580 年代）与两词 1700 年前后分家的编年。
evidence: Etymonline: "pattern (n.) a Modern English variant of patron, retaining its other old sense of \"outline, plan, model, an original proposed for imitation,\" from Old French patron \"patron, protector; model, pattern.\" The difference in form and sense between English patron and pattern wasn't firm before 1700s."

Etymonline: "The meaning \"a design or figure corresponding in outline to an object that is to be fabricated and serving as a guide for its shape and dimensions\" is by late 14c. Extended sense of \"repeated decorative design\" is from 1580s."

Oxford: "Middle English patron 'something serving as a model', from Old French from Latin patronus 'protector of clients, defender', from pater, patr- 'father'. The change in sense is from the idea of a patron giving an example to be copied. By 1700 patron ceased to be used of things, and the two forms became differentiated in sense."
pattern.mechanism_sentence: pattern 本是 patron 的另一副拼写：庇护人立下的「榜样」，先变成照着仿制的图样，再变成反复出现的图案与模式——1700 年前后，它才与管「人」的 patron 彻底分家。

semantic_path.how: 桥是『榜样』：庇护人是供人效仿的典范（牛津明言此转折），中古英语 patron 便兼指『可供仿作的原型』；14 世纪末添『照着它定形状尺寸的图样』义——pattern 正是 patron 的变体拼写。
从『一张样板』扩成『反复出现的样子』：1580 年代添『重复的装饰图案』义，1792 年有裁缝纸样义——词库今义『图案；模式』即此支；1700 年前后 pattern 与 patron 拼写、词义正式分家。

changes: original_meaning 改按后期拉丁语 pedale 的 gloss「脚用的（部件）」：现行字段混入法语 pédale 的行话 gloss「用脚的把戏」，不是该词的原义。
semantic_path 按 Etymonline 编年重建三站（风琴脚踏杠杆 1610 年代 → 1789 年泛指脚踏机件 → 1888 年自行车动词义）。
evidence: Etymonline: "pedal (n.) 1610s, \"lever (on an organ) worked by foot,\" from French pédale \"feet, trick with the feet,\" from Italian pedale \"treadle, pedal,\" from Late Latin pedale \"(thing) of the foot,\" neuter of Latin pedalis \"of the foot,\" from pes (genitive pedis) \"foot\""

Etymonline: "The word was extended by 1789 to any part of a machine or apparatus which transmits power from the foot of the operator... pedal (v.) \"to work with a pedal, use the pedals,\" 1866 of musical organs, 1888 of bicycles"
Oxford: "early 17th cent. (denoting a foot-operated lever of an organ): from French pédale, from Italian pedale, from Latin pedalis 'a foot in length', from pes, ped- 'foot'."
pedal.mechanism_sentence: pedal 的芯是拉丁语 pes「脚」：1610 年代它是管风琴上脚踩的杠杆，后来扩成一切脚踏机件，最后在自行车上当了脚蹬，还兼了动词「骑」。

semantic_path.how: 1610 年代入英语时很专：只指管风琴上用脚踩的杠杆；1789 年起扩到任何靠脚传力的机件部件——从乐器零件，长成了机械通名。
自行车时代认领了它：1888 年 pedal 作动词指『踩脚蹬（骑车）』——词库的名词『脚蹬子』与动词『骑』都在这一站落定。

changes: original_meaning 与古英语 pilian 的 gloss 对齐为「剥皮，去壳」，并在 mechanism_sentence 写明其拉丁语动词 pilare『去毛』的来路。
semantic_path 第二站 how 补名词义的分化年代（14 世纪末 pill、1580 年代 peel 名词定型），替换套话。
mechanism_sentence 重写（原句为罗列式）。
evidence: Etymonline: "peel (v.) \"to strip off\" the skin, bark, or rind from, developed from Old English pilian \"to peel, skin, decorticate, strip the skin or ring,\" and Old French pillier, both from Latin pilare \"to strip of hair,\" from pilus \"hair\"... Probably also influenced by Latin pellis \"skin, hide.\""
Etymonline: "peel (n.1) \"piece of rind, bark, or skin,\" especially of a citrus fruit, 1580s, from earlier pill, pile (late 14c.), from the source of peel (v.)."
peel.mechanism_sentence: peel 的拉丁老底 pilare 是「去毛」（pilus 就是毛发）：去毛、剥皮、削果皮一脉相承；1580 年代起，剥下来的那一层皮也归这个词管了。

semantic_path.how: 动作生出了产物（转喻）：14 世纪末已有 pill 指剥下来的一层皮，1580 年代 peel 作名词定型，专指果皮、树皮这类『被剥下的一层』——词库的名词义『果皮』即此。
semantic_path.meaning: 果皮，表皮（被剥下的一层）

changes: original_meaning 收为拉丁语 pensio 的 gloss「付款，分期偿付」：现行字段把『重量』也列入，那是词根动词 pendere 的字面义、不是名词 pensio 的义项。
semantic_path 按 Etymonline 编年重建两站（14 世纪末服务报酬 → 1520 年代酬谢旧劳的定期付款/养老金），how 写明收窄的两个限定。
evidence: Etymonline: "from Latin pensionem (nominative pensio) \"a payment, installment, rent,\" from past-participle stem of pendere \"to hang, cause to hang; weigh; pay\""
Etymonline: "pension (n.) late 14c., pensioun, \"payment for services,\" especially \"a regular reward or annual payment out of a will or benefice\""

Etymonline: "Meaning \"regular payment to a person in consideration of past service\" is from 1520s, hence \"periodic payment made to a person retired from service on account of age or disability\" (originally especially government pay to soldiers and sailors)."
pension.mechanism_sentence: pension 是拉丁语 pensio「一笔付款」（pendere 又称重量又付钱——古代的钱是称出来的）：14 世纪末它泛指服务的报酬，1520 年代起专管酬谢旧日劳绩、按期发放的那一份——养老金。

semantic_path.how: 泛付款收窄成『酬往』的定期钱：英语 14 世纪末先泛指服务报酬与年金，1520 年代定型为『酬谢过去服务的定期付款』，专指退役（起初多为军人、水手）年老伤残后的那份——词库今义『养老金，退休金』即此。
